title: 第二章 非愿
novel_title: 穿书被杀妻证道？魔尊追妻夜夜哄
content_zh:
所幸原身天赋极佳，二十二岁便已修至金丹中期，身负变异冰灵根，在整个修仙界都算天之骄女，有这开局，只要她谨慎行事，彻底避开主线纷争，安安分分修炼，苟住性命的机会还是很大的。

    引路侍女带着她又行了一段，终于在一座精巧的阁楼前停下。

    “三小姐，涣月阁到了。”

    谢清猗抬头望去，阁楼飞檐翘角，灵气比别处更浓郁几分，她心下却提了起来，这位向来与原身疏远的大伯母，突然召见，恐怕不是叙家常那么简单。

    原身常年居于天极仙府，与谢家人本就不亲，若有好事，断不会轮到她。

    一踏入阁内，就见气氛微妙。

    两名年轻女子坐在右侧下首的梨花木椅上，正是原身的两位堂姐。

    主位之上，家主夫人荣怀音端坐着，今日到不似记忆中那般严厉模样，眉宇间竟透着一丝温和，她左侧则坐着一位通身珠光宝气，眉眼倨傲的年轻妇人。

    谢清猗步履未停，径直走到末位椅子前坐下，她朝主位的荣怀音微微颔首，便垂眸装模作样地理着袖口。

    阁内仿佛静了一瞬。

    坐在荣怀音左侧的那位陌生妇人，法袍流光萦绕，发间一枚青玉发簪，对方并未因她的失礼而动怒，反而那双细长的眼眸里闪过一道精光，随后抬手轻抿了口茶，目光再次落在谢清猗脸上。

    那细长的眼里只有冰冷倨傲，眼尾却带着笑意。

    “这便是三姑娘？”陌生夫人开口，声音低柔，在这安静的殿内很是清晰，她的目光始终在谢清猗身上，并未理会一旁荣怀音讨好的附和。

    “听说你小小年纪已是金丹修为，倒是不负‘天极双姝’的名头。能在彦衡道祖座下，剑意也自是有几分神采吧。”冷傲的陌生夫人唇角微微地弯了一下，“倒比我想的，更合适些。”

    谢清猗微微抬眸看了过去，随口又收回眼神，心想，这个女的是不是脑袋有什么问题，在那自言自语的。

    荣怀音脸上的笑容加深了些，她眸光微闪，不着痕迹地瞥了谢清猗一眼，对她使了个眼色，“猗儿这孩子，自小有主意，在仙府修行，规矩自然是顶天的，薛夫人莫怪她失礼。”

    下一息，家主夫人看向谢清猗，语气温和很是亲昵道：“只是女儿家大了，终究要有归宿，我们谢家不比以往，能为你筹谋的有限。青州薛家是何等门第，薛堇少主更是年少成名，风仪出众。”她轻笑着，“这门亲事，不知是多少人求不来的福缘，大伯母是真心替你着想，怕你年轻，错过了那便再难遇上。”

    荣怀音微胖的面颊因堆起笑容更显慈爱，她朝谢清猗招手：“猗儿，坐得离大伯母近些，你回来这几日，咱娘俩都未曾好生说说话呢。”语气温和，俨然一位关爱晚辈的长辈。

    这时，坐在下首的二堂姐谢之涵轻轻“呀”了一声，用团扇半掩着唇，眼波流转，声音又软又娇：“三妹妹久不在家，怕是还不知道吧？前些日子邓家可是托了中间人往薛家递话，都被婉拒了呢，薛夫人这是真心看重妹妹，才亲自登门。”
content_en:
Fortunately, her original talent was extremely good, and she had already reached the middle stage of Golden Core cultivation at the age of twenty-two. She was blessed with a mutated ice spirit root, and was regarded as a proud girl in the entire world of immortal cultivation. With this start, as long as she acted cautiously, completely avoided the main line of disputes, and practiced peacefully, she still had a good chance of surviving.

    The maid who led the way took her for a while, and finally stopped in front of an exquisite attic.

    "Third Miss, Huanyue Pavilion has arrived."

    Xie Qingyi looked up and saw the cornices of the attic. The aura was a bit stronger than elsewhere, but she felt in her heart that the sudden summons of this aunt who had always been estranged from her original body might not be as simple as a family talk.

    She originally lived in Tianji Immortal Mansion all year round and was not close to the Xie family. If something good happened, it would never be her turn.

    As soon as you step into the pavilion, you will see a subtle atmosphere.

    Two young women are sitting on the pearwood chairs at the lower right side. They are the original two cousins.

    On the throne, the wife of the house, Rong Huaiyin, was sitting upright. Today, she was no longer as stern as she remembered, with a hint of gentleness in her brows. On her left, sat a bejeweled young woman with arrogant features.

    Xie Qingyi walked straight to the last chair and sat down without stopping. She nodded slightly to Rong Huaiyin, who was in charge, then lowered her eyes and pretended to trim her cuffs.

    The pavilion seemed to be quiet for a moment.

    The strange woman sitting on the left side of Rong Huaiyin had a flowing robe and a sapphire hairpin in her hair. The other party was not angry because of her rudeness. Instead, a light flashed in her slender eyes. Then she raised her hand and took a sip of tea, and her eyes fell on Xie Qingyi's face again.

    There was only cold arrogance in those slender eyes, but there was a smile at the end of them.

    "Is this the third girl?" the strange lady said, her voice soft and clear, in this quiet palace, her eyes were always on Xie Qingyi, and she ignored Rong Huaiyin's flattering agreement.

    "I heard that you have already mastered the golden elixir at a young age, and you live up to the name of the 'Twin Sisters of the Heaven'. Being able to be under the throne of Yan Heng Dao Ancestor, your swordsmanship must be somewhat impressive." The cold and arrogant strange lady's lips curved slightly, "It is more suitable than I thought."

    Xie Qingyi raised his eyes slightly and looked over, then looked back casually, wondering if there was something wrong with this woman's head and she was talking to herself there.

    The smile on Rong Huaiyin's face deepened, her eyes flickered, she glanced at Xie Qingyi without any trace, and winked at her, "Yi'er, this child, has had ideas since she was a child. She practices in the Immortal Mansion, and the rules are naturally upheld. Mrs. Xue, don't blame her for being rude."

    The next breath, the wife of the family looked at Xie Qingyi, and said in a gentle and affectionate tone: "It's just that my daughter's family has grown up, and she will eventually have a home. Our Xie family is no better than before, and we can only plan for you in a limited way. What kind of family is the Xue family in Qingzhou? Young Master Xue Jin has become famous at a young age and has outstanding grace." She chuckled, "This marriage is a blessing that many people can't ask for. My eldest aunt is really thinking about you and is afraid that if you miss it, it will be difficult for you to meet again."

    The smile on Rong Huaiyin's fat cheeks made her look even more loving. She waved to Xie Qingyi: "Yi'er, sit closer to my eldest aunt. In the past few days since you've been back, we haven't had a good time talking to each other." Her tone was gentle, as if she was an elder who cared about the younger generation.

    At this time, the second cousin Xie Zhihan, who was sitting at the bottom, let out a soft "ah", half-covered her lips with a fan, her eyes were moving, and her voice was soft and delicate: "The third sister has been away from home for a long time, maybe she doesn't know yet? A few days ago, the Deng family asked an intermediary to send messages to the Xue family, but they were all declined. Mrs. Xue really valued her sister, so she came in person."
